The lower part is square EFGB, and F and B are the two endpoints of one of its diagonals. The sides of the two squares are correspondingly parallel in the figure. Reasoning: The diagonal length of square ABCD is 7 cm, so the distance from vertex D to center P is half of the diagonal, that is DP = 3.5 cm. The diagonal FB of square EFGB is 10 cm long. Since the sides of the two squares are correspondingly parallel, DB and FB are respectively along opposite 45-degree directions, therefore DB ⟂ FB. When taking DP as the base of triangle FPD, the height from F to line DP is FB = 10 cm. So area = (1/2) × DP × FB = (1/2) × 3.5 × 10 = 17.5.

method.method_draft: Use a direct base-height argument along the drawn diagonals. From the image, D and B are opposite vertices of square ABCD, and F and B are opposite vertices of square EFGB. Since P is the intersection of the diagonals of ABCD, P lies on diagonal DB, so DP is half of the 7 cm diagonal, namely 3.5 cm. The line FB is the diagonal of square EFGB, length 10 cm. Because the two squares are drawn with corresponding sides parallel, diagonal DB of the upper square and diagonal FB of the lower square make opposite 45-degree angles with the horizontal, so FB is perpendicular to DB. Thus FB is the altitude from F to the line containing DP. Compute area triangle FPD as (1/2)(DP)(FB) = (1/2)(3.5)(10) = 17.5.

method.method_draft: Set up coordinates from the diagram. Place B at (0,0), with the shared horizontal direction EB/AB to the left and the vertical direction upward/downward as drawn. Let the side length of square ABCD be s = 7/sqrt(2), and the side length of square EFGB be t = 10/sqrt(2). From the image layout, A = (-s,0), D = (-s,s), F = (-t,-t). Since P is the center of ABCD, P = (-s/2,s/2). Then compute the area of triangle FPD by the determinant formula: area = (1/2)|det(P-F, D-F)|. Substitution gives area = (1/2)st = (1/2)(7/sqrt(2))(10/sqrt(2)) = 17.5.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有两个正方形共享点 B 附近的水平边线。正方形 ABCD 位于上方，AB 是其底边，D 在 A 的正上方，C 在 B 的正上方；点 P 标在正方形 ABCD 内部，是其两条对角线的交点。正方形 EFGB 位于下方，EB 是其上边，FG 是其下边，F 在 E 的正下方。阴影三角形的顶点是 F、P、D。推理：按图建立坐标系，令 B=(0,0)，水平向左为负 x 方向，竖直向上为正 y 方向。正方形 ABCD 的对角线长为 7，所以边长 s=7/sqrt(2)；正方形 EFGB 的对角线长为 10，所以边长 t=10/sqrt(2)。由图中位置可取 A=(-s,0)，D=(-s,s)，F=(-t,-t)。P 是正方形 ABCD 的中心，所以 P=(-s/2,s/2)。三角形 FPD 的面积为 (1/2)|det(P-F, D-F)|。其中 P-F=(t-s/2,t+s/2)，D-F=(t-s,t+s)。行列式为 (t-s/2)(t+s)-(t+s/2)(t-s)=st。因此面积为 (1/2)st=(1/2)(7/sqrt(2))(10/sqrt(2))=35/2=17.5。
